//: Emits dist/: ESM JavaScript and its declarations. Generated, ignored by
git, built by `bun run build` (which `bun run test` runs first) and
Node refuses to strip types under node_modules, so a Node consumer needs
JavaScript; the sources import with explicit `.ts` specifiers, rewritten
to `.js` here. Bun keeps running src/ through the `bun` export condition.
The declarations have to exist: pointing `exports.*.types` at the raw .ts
would put this package's sources inside the consumer's program, checked
producing errors inside node_modules that no consumer can fix.
Consumers install the published package from GitHub Packages: a git
dependency has no dist/ unless the consumer builds it.
